notes.title: The Grim Ending: first permanent price reduction
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Steam Community,[/b]

times are not easy and it's not getting easier! But let's make the best out of it:
We have listened to you and are very happy to meet you with a new offer: The Grim Ending is now permanently reduced to 7.99 USD.

[b]You have just bought the game for the full price? [/b]

Thank you for your support! If you bought the game already for the full price and before January 15th, just come back to us by email 
[url=https://www.sinjen.ninja/contact]info@sinjen.ninja [/url]
and send us your receipt! 
You will get the next game that we will release in the coming months for free!

We very much hope you enjoy The Grim Ending and wish you all good health.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/757850/The_Grim_Ending/

notes.title: The Grim Ending - Release
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Community. 

the time has finally come; SINJEN is online with the first game: "The Grim Ending". 
It's an old school story-driven point and click adventure game.
It will be an exciting little adventure for you to play. Here you can solve a few puzzles and in the end you even decide on an moral attitude. We are super proud with this first little installment! We hope you can enjoy our product as much as we do. There will be even more to come over this year!

Kind regards
The Astroknight
